caption: The drawing depicts a round, tan clay jar with two ear-shaped handles, one on each side. The jar has a thick rim, and around the neck, it is inscribed with "COERLEARS HOOK." The main body of the jar features a black floral or foliate design with flowing, curved lines and rounded, leaf-like shapes. Above the jar, there is a horizontal, rectangular label with the text "N. YORK" written in all capitals on a light background. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a small rectangular inset showing a close-up of the black decorative motif from the jar. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist’s signature, "JOHN DANA," appears below the jar. The drawing uses shades of brown, beige, tan, black, and some blue-gray tones for the handles and decoration.
title: Stoneware Jar
